title: Three Tests For French Spreads
gist: Teaser: Gavekal argues the 10-year OAT-bund spread (150bp peak on Oct 2, 139bp latest) is repricing rather than tightening and should settle in a broad 125-300bp range. Global bond moves (a Treasury sell-off widened it 14bp intraday) will push it within that band, but idiosyncratic French risk will persist.

insights.claim: The 10-year French OAT-bund spread touched 150bp on October 2, 2026, retraced to 127bp, then widened again to 139bp within the same week.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Spread volatility is high; intra-week swings of 20bp+ show the market has not found an equilibrium.
insights.quote: After touching 150bp last Friday, October 2, the 10-year OAT-bund spread retraced to 127bp on Tuesday, before widening again to 139bp Thursday.

insights.claim: Gavekal sees the recent retracement in French spreads not as the start of meaningful tightening but as part of a structural repricing.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Investors should not treat dips in the OAT-bund spread as a durable tightening signal.
insights.quote: Rather than beginning a meaningful tightening, the spread appears to be undergoing a repricing

insights.claim: The 10-year OAT-bund spread is likely to settle somewhere between 125bp and 300bp, an admittedly very broad range.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Downside floor near current levels but tail risk toward 300bp implies asymmetric risk for long-OAT positions versus bunds.
insights.quote: likely to see it settle somewhere between 125bp and 300bp

insights.claim: Global bond market moves are a key driver of French spreads: the spread widened as much as 14bp intraday on a Wednesday as the global bond sell-off resumed and pushed US Treasury yields higher.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: French spreads trade with high beta to global duration sell-offs; Treasury yield spikes are a widening catalyst.
insights.quote: The French spread widened as much as 14bp during the day’s session as the global bond sell-off resumed
insights.locator: Wednesday’s price action was a reminder

insights.claim: A rally in global bonds could ease widening pressure on French spreads, pulling them toward the lower end of the range.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: A global duration rally is a potential path to spread compression, linking the French trade to a broader bond-buying view.
insights.quote: any rally in global bonds (see Reasons To Start Buying Bonds) could ease the widening pressure on French spreads
insights.locator: Wednesday’s price action was a reminder

insights.claim: Regardless of global bond market direction, France-specific risk is unlikely to disappear, keeping a persistent premium in French spreads.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Even a benign global backdrop should not be expected to return OAT-bund spreads to pre-crisis tights.
insights.quote: Whatever happens globally, however, idiosyncratic French risk is unlikely to disappear.
insights.locator: Wednesday’s price action was a reminder
